criteria.statement: Cleanup requests dispatch Loom Kind 5100 jobs targeted to the requested worker with bash -c cleanup script and cleanup environment metadata.
Per-worker in-flight dedupe and 30 minute configurable cooldown reject duplicate cleanup attempts; queue-capacity rejection does not burn cooldown.
Protected refs include active assignment metadata image_ref and standby assignment artifact_ref when available.
worker.cleanup.request validates worker existence/liveness and publishes a dispatch result including loom_job_id, cleanup_mode, and worker_pubkey without waiting for terminal Loom job completion.
Pressure auto-trigger defaults to recommend_only and only dispatches reclaimable_only when config enables auto and worker label bahia.cleanup.auto=true.

Workers page cleanup action publishes Bahia control-plane Kind 6006 with worker.cleanup.request tags and JSON content including worker_pubkey, idempotency_key, cleanup_mode, reason, and operator metadata.
Cleanup dispatch enforces AdmissionScopeCleanup, validates bash/docker cleanup capability requirements before dispatch, and requires/configures an internal payment token for paid workers.
